name: room_check
description: One row per photo: how many people are in the room, and two safety questions. Any field the model cannot see must be "unknown", never a guess.

fields.name: n_people
fields.description: total number of people in the photo

fields.name: exit_sign_visible
fields.description: is an exit sign visible in the photo

fields.name: walkway_blocked
fields.description: is a walkway blocked by furniture, bags or boxes

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: how sure you are about the counts

fields.name: notes
fields.description: one short sentence on anything that made the photo hard to read
